correctness.rationale: Definitions and nonregular boundary match arXiv:2605.16525v2 Definition 8. Girth at least five gives direct cancellation basis Omega2 = sum of local neighbor-augmentation modules and zero Omega3. The first boundary on Omega2 is injective by independent port pairs (determinant 1-xi), and its second boundary has image generated by pairs with a common neighbor, rank n-c. Thus the q=2 second cycles have dimension (2m-n)-(n-c)=2m-2n+c; q=2 H2 is not improperly replaced by Omega2. Full proof is in RESULT.md; 26 independent finite-field full-complex checks over F7 and F13 confirm all ranks, not the universal assertion.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete low-degree homology and representation classification for the infinite family of all connected high-girth bidirected graphs, with exact parity-sensitive zero-dimensional behavior and second q=2 homology rank 2m-2n+c. It distinguishes trees, odd cycles, even cycles, and high-girth branched graphs, while computing every automorphism character from ordinary fixed-point data; these structural facts are not mere finite samples or renamings.
